A_instrument.statement: The governed execution pipeline runs and retains truthful evidence.

B_cell_observation.statement: A particular C3 cell scored differently from its paired control.

C_task_pair.statement: Structured replay changed performance on one frozen task pair under one model snapshot.

D_corpus_m0.statement: Across the preregistered frozen task corpus, the mean paired exact-set-match difference met the preregistered continuation threshold under the frozen model/runtime contract and validity gates.

E_general_thesis.requires_for_E: Independent multi-model replication, multi-host runtime, multi-corpus families, and preregistered cross-lab replications beyond D.
E_general_thesis.statement: Broader claim about substrate-owned continuity as a general mechanism.

claim_licensing.aa_failure: An A/A exact-match discrepancy was observed; unresolved pipeline/runtime asymmetry invalidates the M0-v2 interpretation.
claim_licensing.continuation_only: A positive primary result licenses continuation only; it does not establish the general Conditioned Kernel thesis.
claim_licensing.incomplete_coverage: Primary-pair or negative-control coverage was incomplete; no corpus-level scientific claim is licensed.
claim_licensing.leakage_after_freeze: Post-freeze leakage detection invalidated the experiment; no efficacy claim.
claim_licensing.mixed_families: Task-family outcomes were mixed; only the preregistered aggregate rule applies; no cherry-picked family claim is licensed.
claim_licensing.negative_control_failure: The preregistered scrambled-state negative control produced mean_D_NC >= +0.25 or mean_D_NC >= mean_D_C3; the intended substrate interpretation is not licensed.
claim_licensing.negative_result: Under the frozen M0-v2 contract, the mean paired exact-set-match difference was <= -0.25: structured replay underperformed the flat control on the deciding metric. This materially weakens the M0-v2 hypothesis for this frozen corpus, model snapshot, and runtime contract.
claim_licensing.null_result: Under the frozen M0-v2 contract, the mean paired exact-set-match difference fell strictly inside (-0.25, +0.25). No minimally relevant paired advantage of structured replay over the flat control is claimed.
claim_licensing.positive_primary: Under the frozen M0-v2 corpus, model snapshot, runtime contract, and paired control design, the mean paired exact-set-match difference for structured replay versus the flat control met the preregistered continuation threshold, while the scrambled-state and A/A validity gates passed.
claim_licensing.provenance_failure: Runtime or model-identity provenance failed; no scientific claim is licensed.

C0_bare.must_not: prior accepted state, accepted_relations, gold triples
C0_bare.name: Natural baseline
C0_bare.supplies: Episode-B task instructions and current query only.

C1_budget_matched_bare.must_not: canonical gold triples; mechanically complete recipe whose only possible result is the gold set; model-visible condition identity
C1_budget_matched_bare.name: Flat state-mass control
supersedes: RUN 00.6D/00.6F C1 as mere byte-matched bare without state-mass content
any C1 definition that exposes accepted relations
C1_budget_matched_bare.supplies: Same candidate state items and comparable non-answer informational mass as C3, with structure that identifies accepted relations destroyed (deterministic noninformative reassignment or permutation).

C2_instruction_identical.name: Instruction and serialization control
C2_instruction_identical.supplies: Operational instructions, schema, packet envelope, formatting, and non-state metadata of C3 without accepted relational state.

C3_static_ck.must_not: byte-identical scorer triples; output-schema serialization of gold; copy-ready expected_relations field; complete output-ready rendering
C3_static_ck.name: Structured verified continuity
C3_static_ck.supplies: Replay-derived structured representation of the actually accepted Episode-A state under representation=structured_state_v1, distinct from the required output schema; model must transform state into the requested answer.

aa_serialization.name: A/A serialization integrity control
aa_serialization.supplies: Two independently compiled but semantically identical controls.

scrambled_state.diagnoses: format/structure benefit independent of true accepted state
scrambled_state.name: Primary negative control (scrambled-state)
scrambled_state.supplies: Same structure, mass, vocabulary, candidate count, status-symbol mass, packet depth, and byte target as C3 where enforceable; accepted-state mapping deterministically permuted so it does not match Episode A.

decision_rule.inconclusive_if: -0.25 < mean_D_C3 < +0.25 under valid full coverage (any positive value below delta_m0 is NOT support)
decision_rule.invalidate_if: leakage after freeze; gold saturation; incomplete coverage; provenance failure; scorer-contract failure; mean_D_NC >= +0.25 OR mean_D_NC >= mean_D_C3; any A/A exact-match discrepancy; runtime/load unqualified
decision_rule.support_continuation_if: mean_D_C3 >= +0.25 AND mean_D_NC < +0.25 AND mean_D_C3 > mean_D_NC AND aa_discrepancy_count == 0 AND primary_pair_coverage==1.0 AND negative_control_coverage==1.0 AND all scientific validity gates pass
decision_rule.weaken_if: mean_D_C3 <= -0.25 under full coverage and valid controls

estimand.failure_handling: null Y when terminal not SCORED; D_i undefined → task excluded from mean; incomplete coverage invalidates primary claim
estimand.justification: Because D_i ∈ {-1,0,1}, mean_i(D_i) equals the net fraction of task-pair wins for C3 over C1. Descriptive paired corpus estimand. Median is rejected as primary: it can discard a net-positive configuration (e.g. 4 wins, 1 loss, 7 ties → median 0).
estimand.missing_pair_handling: exclude task from primary estimand; block scientific headline if primary_pair_coverage < 1.0
estimand.replicate_handling: exactly 1 replicate per task-condition; no retries; no independent-replication claim from identical deterministic reruns
estimand.uncertainty_policy: descriptive only: report mean D and exact task-level table; not an asymptotic estimate; no p-values as primary decision

falsification_table.licensed_claim: paired structured replay underperformed flat control
no minimally relevant paired advantage under frozen rule
structure/format artifact; substrate interpretation not licensed
apparent C3 benefit not attributable to accepted-state mapping
pipeline artifact suspected; no substrate claim
runtime contract broken; no scientific claim
falsification_table.outcome: Runtime provenance failure or unqualified load contract

primary_contrast.isolates: structured accepted-state mapping vs flat state-mass without that mapping
